project_name: Rox Bahamas Admin Console Modernization Blueprint
theme: Island Luxury SaaS (Navy #0B3B5C, Warm Sand #FBF7EF / Off-White, Gold Accent #D4A94A, Emerald #059669)

information_architecture.layout_mode: Collapsible Collapsible Left-Sidebar (Desktop) + Sticky Header with Mobile Bottom Drawer

sections.title: Live Operations & KPIs
components: Live Booking Stream with Quick Filter Chips

sections.title: Intelligence & Health Analytics
sections.placement: Tabbed Bento Grid (Overview vs Analytics vs Audit)

visual_enhancers.card_styles: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(11,59,92,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(11,59,92,0.08)] transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.skeleton_loaders: animate-pulse bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-100 via-slate-200 to-slate-100 rounded-lg

kpi_cards.grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
kpi_cards.style: p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E2E8F0] flex items-center justify-between hover:border-[#D4A94A]/50 transition-colors
kpi_cards.stat_item: Icon inside colored soft badge (3-line metric layout: title uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] text-[#64748B], main value serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#0B3B5C], trend indicator text-xs font-semibold)

bookings_table.wrapper: rounded-2xl border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-sm
bookings_table.header_filters: p-4 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-[#F8FAFC]
bookings_table.row_style: border-t border-[#E2E8F0] hover:bg-[#F8FAFC]/80 transition-colors duration-150 align-top
bookings_table.status_chips: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider
bookings_table.notify_cell: Collapsible inline drawer with provider status badge (Green check for sent, Red alert badge for error with expandable debug details and 1-tap Force Resend button)

notify_drawer.toggle_button: text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#F1F5F9] text-[#0B3B5C] hover:bg-[#0B3B5C] hover:text-white transition-colors
notify_drawer.content_box: mt-2 p-3 bg-[#FAF9F6] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl text-xs space-y-1 text-[#0B3B5C]

mobile_strategy.viewport_adaptation: Full-width stack on screens < 768px, sticky bottom action bar for primary filters/search, horizontally scrollable data tables with fixed left code column
mobile_strategy.field_owner_features: Large touch targets (min 44px height), direct phone action buttons for driver dispatches, high-contrast text for outdoor daylight usage

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor AdminDashboard.jsx into a clean, tabbed & side-nav layout without removing any backend API queries or state variables.
Preserve all data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='admin-dashboard', data-testid='admin-stats', data-testid='notify-cell-...') so test suites continue to pass seamlessly.
Elevate visual aesthetics to luxury SaaS standards using subtle borders, generous spacing, serif Cormorant Garamond headings, and clear status chip indicators.
Ensure the NotifyCell component provides quick inline toggle for email/SMS provider error details with clear force-resend actions.
Add skeleton loading cards during initial fetch to remove jarring layout shifts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on popovers or sticky headers; use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque background (e.g. bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md).
All interactive elements MUST maintain WCAG AA contrast against background hues.
Add data-testid to all newly introduced tab toggles, buttons, and row actions.
Ensure mobile breakpoints accommodate 320px-414px displays cleanly for field operation.
